content.short: TweetScout is a Twitter-based tool for analyzing crypto projects.
content.description: Dozens of crypto projects surface every day, and users struggle to identify which ones are truly worthy of attention and have real potential. They spend significant time researching and interacting with projects, trying to discern trustworthy signals from social activity. There isn’t a single tool that clearly maps foundations, influencers, and project activity across social channels, making risk assessment difficult. TweetScout brings together crypto-related activity on Twitter into one analytics platform, using signals from accounts, influencers, and follower activity to help evaluate projects more effectively.
